desktop.guided-help.addons-body: Inspect optional integrations. Installing software is an explicit action, never part of this tour.
desktop.guided-help.agent-behavior-body: Set behavior and backup models. Project overrides take precedence over global defaults.
desktop.guided-help.agents-body: Define agents with their own model, effort, instructions and tool rules. You choose the roles.
desktop.guided-help.browser-network-body: Decide whether the browser may reach public websites or only local development addresses.
desktop.guided-help.capabilities-body: Review available tools, automation hooks and privacy boundaries. The tour never widens permissions.
desktop.guided-help.changes-body: Inspect session edits and the working tree. A finished answer is not a substitute for reading the patch.
desktop.guided-help.checkpoints-body: Inspect the selected checkpoint first. Restoring it can change both files and conversation.
desktop.guided-help.commits-body: Review commit attribution and checkpoint preferences. Restoring a checkpoint can change files and conversation.
desktop.guided-help.compaction-body: Configure how older context is compacted. Compaction does not delete your saved conversation.
desktop.guided-help.context-budget-body: More context uses more of the model window. Increase the budget only when the additional context helps.
desktop.guided-help.density-body: Choose comfortable spacing for controls and content. Density and zoom are separate choices.
desktop.guided-help.diagnose-body: Check runtime health and connections. Keep the error details when reporting a problem.
desktop.guided-help.diff-body: Choose how edits are displayed and whether large diffs start collapsed. The edits themselves do not change.
desktop.guided-help.engine-advice-body: Read a second model's opinion without replacing the current conversation.
desktop.guided-help.engine-jobs-body: Read output from commands that keep running. Stop only the job you intend to stop.
desktop.guided-help.engine-link-body: Inspect messages between tabs and agents. Ask an agent to consult another tab by name.
desktop.guided-help.engine-routines-body: Run recurring prompts for this repository. Routines need Empryo running on the repository.
desktop.guided-help.engine-runs-body: Follow parallel reviews, approval gates and bounded retry loops. Each role can use a different model.
desktop.guided-help.feedback-body: Include reproduction steps and relevant diagnostics. Review what you share before sending feedback.
desktop.guided-help.font-body: Turn on Nerd Font icons if your terminal font has them. Files, tools and states then show their icons in the terminal.
desktop.guided-help.general-body: Choose session restoration, message presentation and reliability settings. Check the scope before saving.
desktop.guided-help.git-body: Review status, branches and commits. This tour never stages, commits or pushes your work.
desktop.guided-help.index-body: Inspect the live map of files, symbols, callers and imports. Let indexing finish before judging its results.
desktop.guided-help.instructions-body: Choose the instruction sources that guide the agent. Keep rules specific and avoid conflicting directions.
desktop.guided-help.intel-body: Choose how much repository context reaches the agent. Start with defaults, then tune what is missing.
desktop.guided-help.keys-body: Connect a subscription or API key here. Never paste credentials into a chat.
desktop.guided-help.language-body: Change the language used by the interface. Source code and existing conversations are not translated.
desktop.guided-help.languages-body: Manage support for programming languages. This is separate from the language of the interface.
desktop.guided-help.lsp-body: Inspect definitions, references, diagnostics and rename support for your project languages.
desktop.guided-help.mcp-body: Inspect connected tool servers. Only connect servers you trust with the information and permissions they receive.
desktop.guided-help.metrics-body: Compare activity and performance over time using measurements from your own work.
desktop.guided-help.missing: This control is not visible in the current layout. You can still explore the page.
desktop.guided-help.model-events-body: Inspect calls, retries and errors to understand a slow or interrupted task.
desktop.guided-help.motion-body: Reduce motion for a quieter interface. Grain and mascot controls live here too.
desktop.guided-help.opacity-body: Choose how much of the desktop shows through. Keep enough contrast to read code comfortably.
desktop.guided-help.provider-options-bod: Control reasoning effort and provider-specific options. Available controls depend on the model.
desktop.guided-help.proxy-body: Inspect proxy connections and allowance. A proxy can expose models from several providers.
desktop.guided-help.routing-body: Choose a model and effort for each kind of work. Delegation remains automatic.
desktop.guided-help.safe: The guide opens pages, but never changes settings.
desktop.guided-help.safety-body: YOLO removes approval prompts. Do not enable it just to finish a tour; choose permissions deliberately.
desktop.guided-help.skills-body: Install specialist guidance, then load it when useful. Installing and loading a skill are separate actions.
desktop.guided-help.status-body: Inspect context use and runtime health when a session behaves differently from what you expect.
desktop.guided-help.storage-body: Inspect saved data and cleanup options. The guide never deletes files or sessions.
desktop.guided-help.subagents-body: Follow delegated work, inspect its reports and redirect an agent when its task changes.
desktop.guided-help.subscriptions-body: Inspect connected subscription accounts and their allowances. The guide never signs you in or out.
desktop.guided-help.theme-body: Preview themes and light or dark appearance. This guide keeps your current theme.
desktop.guided-help.title: Explore Empryo
desktop.guided-help.usage-body: Compare actual spend by model and session. A cheaper token price does not always mean a cheaper task.
desktop.guided-help.voice-body: Talk instead of typing. Choose the transcription model and your language, and turn on live dictation to see words while you speak.
desktop.guided-help.web-search-body: Choose your search setup. Provider-native search and Empryo search can have different capabilities and costs.
desktop.guided-help.window-body: Adjust scaling and window appearance without changing how the model works.
